docs.title: Comp Bio AI Engineering
docs.text: This project brings together computational biology concepts with AI and engineering workflows. The goal is to organize research, tooling, and practical experiments into a clean documentation site.

docs.title: Project goals
docs.text:
• Document the project structure and workflow clearly.
  • Capture key concepts from computational biology and AI engineering.
  • Provide a reproducible reference for future experiments and research.

docs.title: Repository layout
docs.text:
• Material/: supporting learning materials and references.
  • plan/: planning notes and design documentation.
  • README.md: repository-level project overview.

docs.title: Local documentation
docs.text:
To build the docs locally:

python3 -m pip install -r requirements.txt
mkdocs serve

The site will be available at http://127.0.0.1:8000 while the development server is running.

docs.title: Prerequisites
docs.text:
Before you begin, make sure you have:

  • Python 3.10 or newer
  • Git installed
  • A GitHub repository configured for GitHub Pages

docs.title: Run the documentation locally
docs.text:
mkdocs serve

This starts a local development site with live reload.

docs.title: Build the static site
docs.text:
mkdocs build

The generated files are placed in the site/ directory.

docs.title: Deploy to GitHub Pages
docs.text:
This repository includes a deployment workflow in .github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml.

When changes are pushed to the main branch, GitHub Actions builds the site and publishes it to the gh-pages branch for GitHub Pages hosting.
